method: offline PAK extraction and independent cooked Blueprint export; no running game inspected

observations: UI_MainMenu_AttemptLogin enters graph statement 6523; statement 6466 invokes native FrontendLoginCallbackProxy.AttemptLogin and 1763 activates the callback proxy.
Statement 902 calls DaytonLoginStatusFunctionLibrary.IsOfflineMode; statement 762 branches on the result.
Statement 1605 calls FrontendMoviePlayer.OnUserLoggedIn in a separate login-success path.
Success delegate bound at statement 3221 enters the path around 3267 and then 1508/1605; failure delegates enter 2153/2314 and call ShowLoginFailureMessageAndReturnToWelcomeScreen.
The literal 'Play Offline' belongs to ConfirmDaybreakMultiplayerEnabled, a Daybreak multiplayer choice, not an account-free login option.

The login success delegate carries PlayerId and LoginStatus; the success path passes PlayerId to FrontendMoviePlayer.OnUserLoggedIn. The failure path passes LoginStatus to ShowLoginFailureMessageAndReturnToWelcomeScreen.

unverified_requirements: Native FrontendLoginCallbackProxy result and failure contracts
Whether IsOfflineMode is available without a prior signed-in Xbox profile
Local save/profile identity and persistence when no account has ever signed in
Whether game states after login can function with an anonymous local profile

native_image.note: These names prove distinct error statuses exist; their numeric enum values and control-flow conditions are not yet established. ApiOfflinePlayer has a code reference at RVA 0x84c201, but this does not prove an anonymous identity provider.

reflection_registration.note: These are reflection registration sites, not the runtime login decision body; forcing their success return would not establish a save user.

release_gate: Do not distribute a login-skip mod until a fresh account-free installation can create, save, exit, restart, and reload a single-player community without altering existing profiles.

save_identity_observation.method: Read-only directory shape inspection of the existing local save; values intentionally omitted
save_identity_observation.shape: Saved/Steam/<Steam account identifier>/<second user identifier>/Release/v2/SaveUser.sav and SaveGame_Vanilla_*.sav
save_identity_observation.implication: The current save layout is account-scoped in two layers. A no-account mod needs an explicitly defined stable local identity and migration isolation; a frontend-only skip cannot establish that by itself.
